query:
SELECT access_level::text
        FROM entity_access
        JOIN database_entities d ON d.database_id = entity_access.entity_id
        WHERE entity_id = $1
        AND entity_type = 'database'
        AND source_id = ANY($2)

SELECT access_level::text
        FROM entity_access
        WHERE entity_id = $1
        AND entity_type = 'form'
        AND source_id = ANY($2)

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 'view'
        FROM forms
        WHERE id = $1
        AND audience = 'public'
        AND trashed_at IS NULL
